About the role

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. An overview of this role As Director, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&amp;A), you'll lead finance for GitLab's Research &amp; Development (R&amp;D) organization, our largest operating expense area. You'll be the strategic finance partner to our Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and their leadership team, owning R&amp;D planning, forecasting, and investment decisions. R&amp;D builds our AI-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform, which more than 100,000 organizations use. You'll connect investment in headcount, infrastructure, AI and cloud usage, and tooling to product outcomes, with clear measurement and reliable forecasts. You'll sit at the CTO's staff table, shape GitLab's long-range plan, and help leadership decide where to invest next, making R&amp;D spend predictable. What you’ll do Serve as the finance advisor to the CTO and R&amp;D leadership. Hold partners accountable for execution against plan and connect R&amp;D priorities to company financial targets.
